leadText: Niko (Japanese: ルカ Luka) is a minor recurring character in . She is Liko's doppelgänger.
plainText:
Niko (Japanese: ルカ Luka) is a minor recurring character in . She is Liko's doppelgänger.

==History==
 uniform]]
Niko is a who came from her home region to study at Naranja Academy in the Tera Training course. In Hatenna and the Otherworldly, while traveling with her friends Rob and Dash, the group became lost in the same forest as Liko, Roy, and Dot. After wandering aimlessly for a while, Niko used a vine from a nearby tree to replace a broken strap on her handbag. This sparked the fury of an , as the vine was how it reached its food supply. The group was chased by Annihilape for days until they met Liko and her friends. Despite Roy's insistence that they battle the wild Pokémon together, Niko and her friends fled out of the forest.

In Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four, Niko and her friends were welcomed by Clavell and Jacq along with the other students who had submitted their school reports and thus completed the first part of the training course.

In The Terapagos I Don't Know, Niko, Rob, and Dash participated in Clavell's speech that started the second part of Tera Training.

In Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!, during the conclusion of the course, she, Rob, and Dash heard Clavell's speech regarding the Tera Training Student Battle Tournament that will be held for the course's students. After seeing that Dash had been saddened by failing her exam, Niko tried to cheer her up. Later, Niko was seen battling Ann in the first round of the tournament.

Niko reappeared in HZ126, alongside Rob and Dash at Naranja Academy. She battled against Rob, using Roserade to battle his and later watched Dash battling Liko over whether the Strong Sphere's would remain banned. Following Dash's loss, Niko supported Dash.

In HZ136, Niko, Dash, and Rob were seen helping take away discarded Strong Spheres after Spinel was defeated and his crimes were exposed to the public.

==Character==
Although not much of her personality was shown, in Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger! it was shown that Niko has a supportive side, trying to cheer up Dash after her friend failed the Tera Training.

Niko has at least one other Pokémon, as she participated in the second phase of Tera Training, which requires two Pokémon.
